source.title: Huang’s Trump Ties Face Scrutiny
source.description:
On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the latest from DC. On today’s show, former US Ambassador to the United Nations Nikki Haley, Rep. Chris Deluzio (D-PA), Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis and Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino.

sentences.text: THE REASON WE SAW A BLUE WAVE IS THEY ARE SEEING TOO MUCH CORRUPTION IN D.C., THEY ARE SEEING EVERYBODY BENEFIT FROM WORKING IN D.C. AND NO ONE IS BENEFITING ON THEY WORK HARD AT HOME.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: ISRAEL HAS BEEN THE ONE PARTNER WE HAVE HAD FOR DECADES THAT IS HELPED KEEP THE U.S. SAFE.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: THE IRANIAN REGIME DOESN'T JUST SAY DEATH TO ISRAEL, THEY SAY DEATH TO AMERICA AND DEATH TO ISRAEL.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: ISRAEL HAS BEEN A GOOD PARTNER.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: DON'T SHOOT YOUR PARTNERS.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: YOU NEED TO MAKE SURE YOU LOOK IN THE MIRROR AND REFLECT ON WHAT WAS DONE.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: REPUBLICANS HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY TO SELF-CORRECT.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: WE WIN WHEN WE GO BACK TO OUR CONSERVATIVE VALUES, WHEN WE LEAN FORWARD AND SAY WHAT DOES THE NEW VISION LOOK LIKE.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: THE NEW VISION LOOK LIKE A REPUBLICAN PARTY THAT LEADS WITH PHYSICAL RESPONSE ABILITY, THAT DEALS WITH-- FISCAL RESPONSIBILITY, THAT DEALS WITH DEBT, THAT ACKNOWLEDGES THAT SOCIAL SECURITY WILL GO BANKRUPT IN FIVE YEARS AND 75 MILLION AMERICANS WILL BE AFFECTED BY THAT.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: REPUBLICANS WIN WHEN THEY ACKNOWLEDGE FREEDOMS, MAKING SURE AMERICANS HAVE QUALITY-OF-LIFE AND CAN DO STUFF OF THEMSELVES AND THEIR FAMILIES AND HAVE WAGES THEY KNOW CAN KEEP UP.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: WHEN WE --WE DO THAT WHEN WE KEEP CRIME LESSENED, WHICH THE TRUMP ADMINISTRATION HAS DONE WELL.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: AND WE DO THAT WITH A STRONG NATIONAL SECURITY THAT IS DECISIVE AND ALLOWS US TO HAVE THE SAFETY AND QUALITY OF LIFE WE NEED.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: REPUBLICANS HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: SELF CORRECTION IS UP TO THEM.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: JOE: ALL RIGHT, WE GOT TO WHERE WE WANTED TO GET OT HERE WHEN WE START TALKING ABOUT THE FUTURE OF THE REPUBLICAN PARTY, AMBASSADOR.
sentences.speaker: JOE

sentences.text: YOU JUST SAID THAT JD VANCE WAS COMPLETELY MISGUIDED ON SUCH A CRITICAL ISSUE.
sentences.speaker: JOE

sentences.text: SUR YOU DO NOTELY-- SURELY YOU DO NOT THINK HE IS THE PERSON TRULY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY MOVING FORWARD, DO YOU?
sentences.speaker: JOE

sentences.text: MR. HALEY: IT IS TOO SOON TO TELL WHO WAS GOING TO LEAVE THE REPUBLICAN PARTY GOING FORWARD FOR SOME EVERYONE SAID RON DESANTIS WAS GOING TO BE PRESIDENT AND HE MADE IT OUT OF IOWA.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: I THINK IT IS TOO SOON AND THERE WILL BE MULTIPLE PEOPLE.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: BUT IT IS NOT WHAT YOU SAY, IS WHAT REPUBLICANS DO IN THESE NEXT TWO YEARS.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: WE NEED TO SHOW THE AMERICAN PEOPLE THAT WE FEEL THEIR PAIN, THAT WE HEAR THEM.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: AND WE NEED TO ACT ACCORDINGLY.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: THIS IS A MASSIVE POWER MOVE BY THE AMERICAN PEOPLE SAYING LISTEN TO US.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: YOU DON'T GET TO TELL US HOW WE FEEL.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: BUT AS TELL YOU HOW WE FEEL -- LET US TELL YOU HOW WE FEEL.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: NO MORE PEACOCKING ON TV.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: MAKE SURE WE CAN SHOW THEM REAL RESULTS THAT THEY CAN FEEL IN THEIR HOMES AND MAKE THEM FEEL LIKE THEY ARE MORE CONFIDENT AND STRONG GOING FORWARD.
sentences.speaker: MR. HALEY

sentences.text: KAILEY: LET'S TALK ABOUT HOW THIS IS REFLECTED IN THE SOUTH IN PARTICULAR, BECAUSE IN YOUR STATE OF SOUTH CAROLINA, WE SAW THE INCUMBENT, ALTHOUGH FOR SHORT TIME SHE HAS BEEN SERVING AS SENATOR, DARLINE GRAHAM, GO DOWN IN THE RACE AGAINST ANNIE ANDREWS.
sentences.speaker: KAILEY
